evidence_spans: Saturating Popcount Adder Tree 3539 1.58 ns 0.4 mW
CLM-ARCH-0208.statement: In a 28-nm post-synthesis implementation, the saturating popcount adder tree has a critical path delay of 1.58 ns.

CLM-ARCH-0209.statement: In a 28-nm post-synthesis implementation, the 384 instances of XOR trees consume 0.3 mW of power.

extra_quotes: We evaluate the proposed architecture using a Cadence synthesis flow and a commercial 28-nm standard-cell library.
